CPV.note: Customs payment page; no shared regional link or facility.

facts.fact: The DNRE's online customs clearance payment page takes payment by DUC reference with Vinti4 or Visa cards issued by Cabo Verdean banks, with SISP one-time-password security.

systems.platform: DNRE web portal (Vinti4/Visa cards, SISP OTP)
systems.owner: Direção Nacional das Receitas de Estado
